text: This run looked at the token-factory page without a set buyer or goal. Questions A1-audience, A2-value, A3-proof, and A4-cta failed in the hero (the saved copy from 2026-11-15), so it does not do those jobs yet. The writer tested Variant A for an OpenAI-compatible API, Variant B for enterprise reliability, and Variant C for transparent pricing. Both Jev and Judge 2 passed Variant C because it performed better on the gaps. Variant A was held for a person because Jev flagged a phrase, while Variant B was a near miss that failed Gate 2.
